digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / CI workflow
propositions: External integration tests currently run live against only one provider (Anthropic) despite rebar supporting Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI-compatible providers, leaving provider-specific regressions undetected by CI automation.

Provider selection must become an explicit CI matrix dimension with each arm using REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE to override [llm.model_classes] only, ensuring CI dogfoods the documented local-dev configuration path and avoiding silent fallback to default providers.

Bedrock authentication on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials to a dedicated scoped IAM role, not the EC2 instance-role path used by S7, with explicit region resolution via both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION environment variables.

Missing provider credentials must be detected and cause the corresponding matrix arm to skip loudly and distinctly from passing runs, never silently reading as green or indistinguishable from successful execution.

The ambient default model (cfg.model) must resolve to the declared provider per arm, not fall back to hardcoded Anthropic defaults, requiring fixes to both configuration resolution and test assertions that previously only checked model_classes.
Cost impact of multi-provider matrix must be measured and recorded with an explicit decision on cadence (every trigger vs reduced frequency/subset per provider) and its rationale.
